display_name: Botpress public chat demo (single AI Task node, unhardened)
rationale: Vendor-neutral conservative prior for an unhardened Botpress Cloud demo bot deployed via the public Chat integration. Customer (the deployer of the bot) has not disclosed governance posture, RAG provenance, eval coverage, on-call posture, or incident-response process. Treat all non-measured dims as 'undisclosed = below-average' baseline. Override with a customer-specific prior the moment the customer signs the BEAAA-22 §3 hosted-eval intake.
